# Solar Eclipse Workbench PRODUCTION script - total solar eclipse of 12 August 2026
# Generated by scripts/generate_20260812_production.py - edit that, not this file.
#
# Body   : Fuji Fujifilm X-T4   (Fuji SDK + relay trigger on the remote jack)
#          The Canon EOS 800D is parked; its half of this schedule is in
#          scripts/test/20260812_production_EOS800D.txt, still interleaved with the
#          frames below in case the pair runs again on a second machine.
# Optics : 80/480 mm refractor, fixed f/6.  The body cannot drive a telescope's
#          aperture, so the aperture column says '-' and the setting is skipped.
#          The f/6 still sets every exposure below; it just is not sent to the body.
# Filter : Baader AstroSolar PHOTOGRAPHIC film (ND 4.0) on the scope, for every
#          partial-phase frame.  NOT the ND 5.0 visual film - never look through this.
#
# At f/6 with photographic film the sun wants 1/7139 just after C1 at ISO 100, which
# the X-T4 reaches at its 1/8000 ceiling.
#
# Site   : Palencia, N Spain  42.0095 N, -4.5289 E, 740 m
# Type   : Total, magnitude 1.0119, totality 101 s
#
#   C1     17:33:56 UTC   sun  18.9 deg
#   C2     18:29:10 UTC   sun   8.7 deg
#   MAX    18:30:00 UTC   sun   8.6 deg
#   C3     18:30:51 UTC   sun   8.4 deg
#   C4     19:22:34 UTC   sun  -0.8 deg
#   sunset 19:22:53 UTC
#
# Sunset eclipse: totality is only 8.6 deg up and the sun sets 19 s after C4, so the
# last partials are shot into horizon haze.  A clear, low western horizon matters more
# here than anything else.
#
# Which command does what on this body
# ------------------------------------
#   corona ladders  take_hdr ramps the shutter between frames on gphoto2, but on the
#                   Fuji SDK path it fires 2*stops+1 frames at ONE speed.  The X-T4
#                   uses take_bracket (wired to the SDK bracket_no_download) instead.
#   contact bursts  the relay on the remote jack free-runs CH at ~15 fps, which the
#                   SDK cannot do at all: it returns 0x1008 with the dial on CH.
#
# Atmospheric dimming
# -------------------
# The sun falls from 18.9 deg at C1 to the horizon and airmass climbs from 3.1 to over
# 30, so every filtered frame was computed for the sun altitude at that exact instant:
#   - above 5 deg : Jubier tables, interpolated in sun altitude and site height
#   - below 5 deg : the tables break down, so the 5 deg value is extrapolated with a
#                   Kasten-Young airmass and 0.25 mag/airmass extinction.
# That coefficient is a guess (0.15 clear .. 0.40 hazy) and the error grows to several
# stops at the horizon, hence the wide brackets after C3+18m.  Comments carry the sun
# altitude and airmass X used for each frame.
#
# Partial-phase frames alternate between the bodies, so the pair samples the disc
# twice as often as either alone.
#
# The relay must be connected and registered before the run, or every relay_* line is
# skipped with a warning and the X-T4 loses both contact bursts.  Firing the remote
# jack while the SDK holds the session is still an untested combination - bench it.

# --- Set-up and focus, before C1 (solar filter ON) ---

take_picture, C1, -, 0:18:00.0, Fuji Fujifilm X-T4, 1/8000, -, 100, "Focus check, uneclipsed disc @ 17:15:56, sun 22.2 deg, X=2.6"
take_picture, C1, -, 0:12:00.0, Fuji Fujifilm X-T4, 1/8000, -, 100, "Focus check, uneclipsed disc @ 17:21:56, sun 21.1 deg, X=2.8"
take_picture, C1, -, 0:06:00.0, Fuji Fujifilm X-T4, 1/8000, -, 100, "Framing check, uneclipsed disc @ 17:27:56, sun 20.0 deg, X=2.9"
take_bracket, C1, -, 0:03:20.0, Fuji Fujifilm X-T4, 1/8000, -, 100, +/- 2, "Exposure-check bracket @ 17:30:36, sun 19.5 deg"

# --- TOTALITY (101 s, sun 8.6 deg - FILTERS OFF) ---
# X-T4: relay bursts at both contacts, SDK brackets in between (1.8 fps over USB).
# The frames were laid out for two bodies, staggered so one is always exposing while
# the other reads out; with the 800D parked the gaps it filled are simply empty.
# The X-T4 take_picture before each burst exists to load the beads exposure before
# the relay takes over - the relay fires whatever is already dialled in.
#
# Everything inside a minute of a contact - the bursts and the spoken countdown -
# is scheduled against the limb-corrected moments, because that is when totality
# actually begins and ends.  The cues further out stay on the mean contacts, where
# a few seconds is nothing and not depending on the limb profile is worth more.
#
# The bead bursts are scheduled against the edges of the limb-corrected bead
# window, not against the contacts.  A smooth-Moon C3 is 3.5 s later than the real
# one here, which is most of a burst.  These lines need the lunar limb profile
# installed and the correction switched on; without it they are skipped, and
# Solar Eclipse Workbench says so when the script is loaded.
#
# The beads run 3.25 s at C2 and 4.05 s at C3, against a hold of 1.9 s, so the burst
# cannot cover the whole window.  It is pinned to the contact-side edge, where the
# diamond ring is: the C2 burst ends at BEADS_C2_END, the C3 burst starts at
# BEADS_C3_START, both with 0.3 s of margin towards totality.
#
# The hold is 1.9 s because 28 frames at 15 fps is all the 32-slot transfer queue
# takes; a full queue stops the body dead.  Covering the whole window needs a pulsed
# burst at ~8.6 fps instead of a held one, which is not yet measured on this body.
take_picture, BEADS_C2, -, 0:00:06.0, Fuji Fujifilm X-T4, 1/3200, -, 100, "Load the beads exposure before the relay burst @ 18:29:02, sun 8.8 deg"
relay_arm, BEADS_C2, -, 0:00:04.0, "Pre-arm S1 for the C2 burst @ 18:29:04, sun 8.8 deg"
relay_burst, BEADS_C2_END, -, 0:00:01.6, 1.9, "Diamond ring and Baily's beads at C2, relay at 15 fps @ 18:29:08, sun 8.7 deg"
relay_release, BEADS_C2_END, +, 0:00:01.5, "Open every contact after the C2 burst @ 18:29:12, sun 8.7 deg"
voice_prompt, C2_LIMB, -, 0:00:00.0, C2, "Second contact - filters off, totality has begun"
take_bracket, C2, +, 0:00:06.0, Fuji Fujifilm X-T4, 1/200, -, 400, +/- 2, "Corona bracket A1, inner corona @ 18:29:16, sun 8.7 deg"

take_picture, C2, +, 0:00:46.0, Fuji Fujifilm X-T4, 1, -, 800, "Deep outer corona @ 18:29:56, sun 8.6 deg"
voice_prompt, MAX, -, 0:00:10.0, MAX_IN_10_SECONDS, "Ten seconds to maximum eclipse"

voice_prompt, MAX, -, 0:00:04.0, MAX_IN_4_SECONDS, "4 to maximum eclipse"

take_bracket, C2, +, 0:01:06.0, Fuji Fujifilm X-T4, 1/25, -, 400, +/- 2, "Corona bracket B2, middle corona @ 18:30:16, sun 8.5 deg"
